title: Head of Product, UK SME
jd_excerpt:
Our story:
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
 Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.
 The opportunity:   
 Freelancers, contractors, sole traders and small business owners deserve an easier way to run their business finances. This is the next big focus area for Taxfix in the UK, and this role will shape our future offerings for this segment. As Head of Product for UK Self-Employed & SME, you will be responsible for understanding this customer deeply, setting the vision, shaping the roadmap, and rallying stakeholders to bring incredible customer experiences to life. This is a senior individual contributor role. You have no direct reports and you lead through vision, craft and influence. At Taxfix we call the people who own a problem from idea to shipped product, stretching across product, design and engineering with AI, builders . This is an opportunity to be a product leader and a builder.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Own the vision, roadmap and outcomes. Set a clear product vision and strategy for UK self-employed and small business customers. Agree targets with leadership and your commercial partner and then own them and drive the key results. Make priorities clear and trade-offs visible.
 Be the voice of the self-employed. Know these customers as well as anyone in the company, through direct contact, not distance. Be their ambassador in every decision.
 Own discovery. Lead problem and customer need discovery so the builder teams always have well-qualified, relevant work. Bring your own well-informed ideas, not only a response to a brief.
 Take a product from proof to pillar. Find product-market fit, pour fuel on what works, and make smart build-vs-partner calls, using shared capabilities where it is faster and building where it is core.
 Drive adoption and depth of engagement. Make this the product customers rely on all year, not once. Own activation, retention and how widely customers use what we offer.
 Build the AI-native product. Have a clear point of view on where AI removes real load for the self-employed and for accountants, and push the team to build what was not possible only months ago.
 Run the team on experimentation and data. Make decisions with data, and with strategy and market judgement when the data is unclear. Speed to learning is a first-class metric you own.
 Be the commercial partner, not the commercial owner. Shape the proposition with your commercial partner: tiers, pricing, packaging and bundling. Translate the commercial ambition into a product that delivers it, push back clearly when the product path and the ask do not align, and lead launches together with marketing.
 Build responsibly in a regulated space. Work with compliance, financial crime and tax experts so that what you ship meets regulatory standards and is accurate, explainable and safe, including the edge cases and the risks that come with AI.
 Set the bar for craft. Set direction for the teams you work with. Give them a vision sharp enough to act on and help remove handoffs and bottlenecks. Be entrepreneurial and lean in to build directly when needed. Credibility and influence matter more than authority.
 Your profile: 
 Your track record 
 You have led product for a multi-team area, ideally for consumer or micro-SME customers, in a scale-up where you had fewer resources than you wanted and got things done by being hands-on.
 You have taken a product from early traction to a real growth engine, with customers who rely on it, not just sign-ups. You can say why it worked, which metric moved and what you would do differently.
 Experience in accounting, tax, or banking products is a strong plus, as is familiarity with UK tax, Making Tax Digital or HMRC-facing products. 
   You are a builder 
 You have built and shipped with AI yourself, not just written specs about it, and you know when to trust the output, when to edit it and when to reject it.
 You use AI every day, and you are credible with design and engineering because you have built something end to end.
   How you work 
 You are measured by outcomes and decide with data, and with strategy and market judgement when the data is unclear. You believe experimentation is how products win and treat velocity as a metric that matters.
 You lead by influence: you have raised the bar for the people around you, with or without a team of your own, and people who worked with you got better.
 You communicate clearly and concisely, with an ambitious vision for the product and a real curiosity about small businesses.
 You have a bias to action, give feedback directly, own your misses, and are respectful, honest and kind.
 Why Taxfix? 
 A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.
 Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.
 A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.
 Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.
 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.
 A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.
 Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves. 
 Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.
